title: Fleet Rung 31 — THE MEASURED BINDING & THE VENUE EXPANSION (mm-volume v1.3.0 + market-grid v1.2.0): the second calibration dial makes the projection REALITY-anchored, and the venue expansion prices the sidechain per-token from the chain of record. Q13 WHAT IS THE TRUE TAPE RATE? calibratedTape reads the fill-ledger's REAL capture rate (fills/min over the window ending at the LAST fill — the determinism law): 124 real fills in the window measure 0.0861 fills/min ≈ 124 fills/day vs the 10 fpm market-tape prior — the ledger meters OUR capture rate, not the market tape, and the two are carried side-by-side (exec-recon-prior labeled, never a silent rewrite — Q12's law, second dial). Q15 WHAT IS THE REAL CHOKE? the venue projection now runs on min(tape, capacity, CAPTURE) — reality says the choke is the CAPTURE (the fill-through of the current posture: 124/576 = 21.528% of the order capacity), not the order capacity; projected volume 796.032 → 85.684 SBD/day on the measured dials, and the capture grows exactly the way the owner directive says: more rungs × fill-through × funded soldiers × bounded internal flow. Q14 WHICH OTHER VENUES CAN WE PRICE TODAY? the venue expansion: (a) market-grid v1.2.0 measures each Hive-Engine basket token's OWN marketFeePercentage from the tokens contract (absent = zero per-token fee — the whole basket BEE/WAIV/SWAP.DOGE/SWAP.LTC/CENT measured zero-fee 2026-10-04) and probes the Blurt internal market probe-first fail-loud; (b) fee-doctrine.json grows two rows (hive-engine-sidechain per-token law; blurt-internal-market probe-first, dark at registration); (c) mm-volume v1.3.0 prices every HE token by ITS OWN measured fee row (edgeFromSpread: captured spread − round-trip fee, floored at zero — 5 venues priced, WAIV/SWAP.HIVE 3.1% spread at 25bps-class fee law, all basket rows measured zero-fee), with the volume projection waiting for a measured sidechain tape (honest projectionNullReason NO-MEASURED-TAPE-HE, never invented); (d) Blurt measured DARK (no node answered) — booked as an honest dark surface with its reason; the day a node answers, the venue prices itself at 0 bps automatically. Q16 HOW DOES GROWTH RAISE CAPTURE WITHOUT LYING? the share ladder stays the CAPABILITY lens (tape vs capacity, monotonic over N soldiers), the capture bound is the REALITY anchor measured from the ledger, and the plan ledger grows tapeFpm + captureTradesDay so the fill-through becomes a time series like the share.
